problem.text: Translators with several agencies lose track of unpaid invoices.
Deadlines are scattered across agency portals.

customer_segments.text: Freelance translators with three or more agency clients

unique_value_proposition.text: One Notion workspace for every agency job, deadline and invoice

solution.text: Notion templates with a job board, deadline view and invoice tracker

channels.text: Translator forums and the founder's blog mailing list

revenue_streams.text: One-time template price, to be tested
Projected revenue of 5000 USD per month

cost_structure.text: Founder time and a Notion account

strategist.canvas.price_hypothesis: A one-time price of about 19 USD, to be tested

riskiest_assumptions.assumption: Translators feel the invoice pain often enough to switch tools.
riskiest_assumptions.cheap_test: Ask five translators about their last late payment.

riskiest_assumptions.assumption: They want a Notion template rather than an app.
riskiest_assumptions.cheap_test: Ask which tools they already pay for.

riskiest_assumptions.assumption: They would pay for a template.
riskiest_assumptions.cheap_test: Waitlist test against the pre-registered target.

experimenter.design.hypothesis: Freelance translators who juggle several agencies will join a waitlist for an invoice and deadline template.
channels: Translator forums the founder already uses
kill_criteria: Fewer than 10 sign-ups after the first week
experimenter.design.message: See every agency job, deadline and invoice in one place.

copywriter.page.headline: Every agency job, deadline and invoice in one place
copywriter.page.problem: Working with several agencies means many portals, many formats and invoices that slip through.
how_it_works: Copy the template into your Notion.
Add each agency job as it arrives.
See open deadlines and unpaid invoices at a glance.
copywriter.page.who_its_for: Freelance translators who work with several agencies at once.
